results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Coverage of Fabio Giglietto's research on how Meta's algorithms suppress visibility for mainstream political figures while amplifying fringe and extremist content on Facebook, leading to European Commission inquiries.

results.title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei
results.snippet: Article reporting on research led by Prof. Fabio Giglietto analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts, revealing how Meta's content reduction policies disproportionately reduced visibility for institutional politicians compared to extremist accounts.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: Press announcement highlighting how Fabio Giglietto's study on Meta's political content reduction policy prompted a parliamentary question in the European Parliament and an investigation by the European Commission.
